learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will master Simple Present, Past, and Future tenses, and learn to use Present Continuous and Past Continuous tenses to describe ongoing actions.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Verbs are like time machines! They tell us if an action happens every day, happened yesterday, or will happen tomorrow. Let's learn how to travel through time with verbs! ⏳

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Simple tenses tell us when an action happens. Simple Present is for daily habits. Simple Past is for finished actions. Simple Future is for actions that haven't happened yet.
examples_or_templates: Present: I play football every day.
Future: I will play football tomorrow. (Add 'will')

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When an action is going on at this very moment, we use the Present Continuous tense. We make it by using a helping verb (is, am, are) + the main verb ending in '-ing'.
examples_or_templates: I am eating an apple right now.
They are playing in the garden.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: To describe an action that was going on for a while in the past, we use the Past Continuous tense. We use helping verbs (was, were) + the main verb ending in '-ing'.
examples_or_templates: I was sleeping when the phone rang.
The birds were singing all morning.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which sentence is in the Present Continuous tense?
options: She is dancing on the stage.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: She is dancing on the stage.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Fill in the blank for Past Continuous: 'We ______ watching a movie last night.'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Change this sentence to Simple Future tense: 'He writes a letter.'
subjective_practice.hint: What magic word do you need to add to show it will happen later?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank using the Present Continuous form of 'read': 'Shhh! I ________ a book.'
subjective_practice.hint: Remember to use a helping verb (am) and add '-ing' to the main verb.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Identify the tense of this sentence: 'The dog was barking loudly.'
subjective_practice.hint: Look at 'was' and the '-ing' ending. Did it happen now or in the past?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🚀 The Time Machine Diary
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write 3 sentences about your favorite game. 1 in Simple Past (what you did yesterday), 1 in Present Continuous (what you are doing now), and 1 in Simple Future (what you will do tomorrow)!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Simple tenses show daily habits (Present), finished actions (Past), or upcoming actions (Future).
⭐ Present Continuous (is/am/are + ing) describes actions happening right now.
⭐ Past Continuous (was/were + ing) describes actions that were ongoing in the past.
